title: Repricing 20 works: from about 80 steps to 24 clicks
summary: Open Gallery 0.3 adds price and wall-size filters, sorting, bulk repricing with a preview and one-click undo, adding a selection to an exhibition, and small thumbnails in lists.
why: The audit counted the jobs a gallery does every week. After a fair, primary prices go up across a body of work; before a visit, a dealer needs what is available, in budget and fits the client's wall. Both were slow or impossible in 0.2.
detail: Repricing previews every before and after without writing anything, skips sold and unpriced works, rounds to the nearest 100 or whatever you choose, and can be undone exactly. A repriced work counts as edited here, so a later spreadsheet import asks before overwriting it. Width filtering converts units, so a 120 cm canvas is correctly left out of a 40 inch wall. Thumbnails are made in the browser the first time a list opens, since the app has no image library; 59 thumbnails came to about 0.8 MB against megabytes of originals. Still on the list from the audit: large imports pause the app, and exports of very large image archives need streaming.
next: Editions with individual numbered copies, then location history and condition reports.
author: Claude

evidence.label: Browser run: 20-work reprice in 24 interactions, undo restored all prices, 0 page errors
